def min_swaps_to_sort(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    visited = [False] * n
    swaps = 0

    for i in range(n):
        if visited[i] or arr[i] == i + 1:
            continue

        cycle_size = 0
        x = i

        while not visited[x]:
            visited[x] = True
            x = arr[x] - 1
            cycle_size += 1

        if cycle_size > 0:
            swaps += (cycle_size - 1)

    return swaps
